items.question: What ritual substitute must be fashioned there to ensure the sacrifice's success?
premises: A ritual context requires a specific protective arrangement.
A figure made of darbha grass can serve as a priestly substitute.
The prescribed arrangement aims at the success of the sacrifice.
items.inference: One should fashion a priest made of darbha grass there for the success of the sacrifice.
items.plain_english: There one should fashion a priest made of darbha grass for the success of the sacrifice.
